text: You sit with the elders over the scrolls of the Law and the Prophets. Everyone's devotion books grow.
Gamaliel - Saul's own teacher - opens his school's scrolls to you. Everyone's devotion books grow.
In the lecture hall of Tyrannus, where Paul reasoned daily for two years, you study late into the night. Everyone's devotion books grow.
Cornelius gathers his household and friends for a feast, and sends you on your way with gifts.
Lydia, the dealer in purple cloth, insists you stay at her house. Her household feasts with you and loads your satchel.
